finding.problem: For target foreground, BCE has no finite satisfied state: making ray_min_sdf more negative always improves the objective. On silhouette-boundary rays this rewards geometric thickening beyond the source contract and can trade recall improvement for precision loss.
finding.arm_A_supporting_signature: Dense foreground supervision materially improved recall/interior coverage while reducing precision and increasing source-unsupported surface support.
finding.arm_C_supporting_signature: Changing negative-space sampling alone did not close source fidelity while the same non-saturating foreground pressure remained active.

why_no_explicit_zero_set_loss: Given a continuous field and an enclosing normalization domain whose exterior is independently constrained positive, a foreground ray with a negative interior sample already implies at least one zero crossing by continuity. A second near-zero surrogate is redundant and can bias tangent rays.
why_no_differentiable_mesh_raster_yet: Exact source-ray sign constraints are closer to the controlled orthographic silhouette contract and avoid introducing a second extractor proxy before the strengthened V4 field is tested.
why_no_eikonal_yet: The observed blocker is source-contract retention and foreground/background sign pressure, not demonstrated gradient-norm pathology; Eikonal can oversmooth thin features and is held unless V4 produces oscillatory signed-field evidence after source constraints close.
why_no_global_teacher_sdf: Teacher geometry remains FIT-only local structural aid. Global teacher-SDF domination would weaken the diagnostic value of image/source-driven geometry fitting and is unnecessary before the source-contract V4 is tested.
